items.title: Rumour: Bend Studio to announce and launch a new PS5 co-op game in 2027
items.summary: Push Square 引述 MP1st 傳聞，指 Days Gone 開發商 Bend Studio 計劃喺 2027 年公布並有機會同年推出全新第三人稱合作遊戲，且非 Days Gone 續作、亦非 live service。
items.note: Unconfirmed MP1st rumour via Push Square; mark uncertain.
items.imageAlt: Bend Studio / Days Gone related Push Square image

items.title: PS5 dynamic pricing concerns revived by Sony ‘intelligent pricing’ job listing
items.summary: Push Square 報道 Sony 招聘「數位遊戲貨幣化」高級總監，職銜提到推動「intelligent pricing」同精準優惠；玩家擔心 PS Store 動態定價會擴大，儘管目前未見加價實例。
items.note: Push Square byline ~1am UK Oct 31 → HKT morning.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation Store / PS5 pricing story image

items.title: Modders boot Bazzite on PS5 from USB, unlocking optional extra GPU CUs
items.summary: HotHardware 報道模組社群將 Linux 發行版 Bazzite 以 USB 外掛方式喺 PS5／PS5 Pro（韌體 3.00–13.60）開機成 Steam 遊戲模式，並可嘗試解鎖廠方關閉嘅額外 GPU 計算單元；不改機內系統。
items.note: HotHardware Oct 30 2:46 PM EDT → HKT Oct 31 early morning. Jailbreak/community project—not an official Sony feature.
items.imageAlt: PS5 console used to illustrate Bazzite Deck project

items.title: Terrible Lizards dinosaur horror parkour out now on Xbox Series and Game Pass
items.summary: 第一人稱恐龍恐怖跑酷《Terrible Lizards》已喺 Xbox Series X|S 同 Game Pass 推出；玩家喺廢棄恐龍主題公園以跑跳攀爬逃生，無武器、靠移動躲避追逐。
items.note: Xbox Wire Oct 30 developer feature; available now / Game Pass.
items.imageAlt: Terrible Lizards Xbox Wire hero art

items.title: Curse of Resthaven narrative roguelite launches on Xbox Series
items.summary: Hilltop Studios 哥德恐怖敘事 roguelite《Curse of Resthaven》已登陸 Xbox Series 同 Xbox on PC；玩家以總督 Ambrose 喺六日時間循環中調查島嶼、經營城鎮同進行卡牌遠征。
items.note: Xbox Wire Oct 30 tips; body says launches Oct 29.
items.imageAlt: Curse of Resthaven key art

items.title: Xbox Free Play Days: Wuchang, Dead by Daylight, Darkwood, Spirittea, Everspace 2
items.summary: Xbox 週末 Free Play Days 開跑：Game Pass 會員可試玩《WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers》、《Darkwood》、《Spirittea》同《EVERSPACE 2》至 11 月 1 日；《Dead by Daylight》則畀所有 Xbox 玩家免費遊玩至 11 月 2 日。
items.note: Xbox Wire Oct 29; event runs through Nov 1–2.
items.imageAlt: Xbox Free Play Days October 29 lineup art

items.title: Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE sets November 3 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: Netmarble 宣佈動作 RPG《Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE》將於 11 月 3 日下午 4 時（太平洋時間）登陸 PS5 同 Xbox Series；遊戲已先喺 PC 推出，主打影帝成振宇劇情、動態戰鬥同四人協作討伐。
items.note: Gematsu Oct 28 5:22 PM EDT → HKT Oct 29 morning.
items.imageAlt: Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE key art

items.title: Cronos: Lazarus DLC dated December 3 for PC, PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: Bloober Team 宣佈《Cronos: The New Dawn》故事 DLC《Cronos: Lazarus》將於 12 月 3 日登陸 PC、PS5 同 Xbox Series，售價 US$9.99；內容為 Pathfinder 變身 Warden 嘅前傳，Switch 2 版預計 2027 年第一季。
items.note: Bloober Team press Oct 29; Switch 2 Q1 2027.
items.imageAlt: Cronos: Lazarus story trailer thumbnail

items.title: Skyblivion team faces legal threats from a former volunteer, not Bethesda
items.summary: Polygon 報道野心模組《Skyblivion》團隊於 10 月 30 日公開說明，一名前志願者因其程式碼被反編譯而威脅興訟並索取成員個資；團隊已移除相關程式碼，並尋求義務法律協助。
items.note: Polygon Oct 31 11:57 AM EDT → HKT late evening.
items.imageAlt: Skyblivion mod screenshot

items.title: Princess Connect! Re:Dive × Uma Musume collab event and CM go live
items.summary: Cygames《公主連結 Re:Dive》同《賽馬娘 Pretty Derby》合作活動於 10 月 31 日開跑至 11 月 23 日，參與可獲限定角色 Gold Ship，並有 Almond Eye 等 pickup 卡池；同期公開「キャル？」宣傳 CM。
items.note: 4Gamer Oct 31; event noon JST start.
items.imageAlt: Princess Connect × Uma Musume Gold Ship collab art

items.title: Report: EA closed BioWare to prioritize Star Wars Battlefront III over Mass Effect
items.summary: Game Informer 引述 Bloomberg 報道，指 EA 喺《Star Wars Battlefront III》同 BioWare 下一部《Mass Effect》之間選擇前者投資，因而關閉 BioWare 並中止 Mass Effect 開發；官方未全面證實細節。
items.note: Based on Bloomberg via Game Informer Oct 30; BioWare closure itself was earlier—mark uncertain on Battlefront III rationale.
items.imageAlt: Mass Effect character Liara art used with Game Informer story

items.title: Studio Atelico launches on-device Atelico AI Engine into Early Access
items.summary: GamesIndustry.biz 報道 Studio Atelico 將本機運行嘅 Atelico AI Engine 開放 Early Access，支援 Unity、Unreal 同 Godot，可做影像／語言模型／語音同角色 AI，強調唔依賴雲端、唔拖累繪圖效能。
items.note: GI.biz Oct 30 2:39 p.m. UTC → HKT.
items.imageAlt: Atelico AI Engine screenshot

items.title: Roblox Q3 revenue rises 16% to $1.6bn as bookings fall 12%
items.summary: GamesIndustry.biz 報道 Roblox 2026 年第三季收入按年升 16% 至 16 億美元，優於預期；但預訂額跌 12% 至 17 億，日活躍同使用時數亦回落，公司同時強調 AI 創作工具滲透率。
items.note: GI.biz Oct 30 10:44 UTC → HKT.
items.imageAlt: Roblox branding image

items.title: Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 4th Anniversary update goes live with Marian: Queen
items.summary: Level Infinite／SHIFT UP《勝利女神：NIKKE》四周年更新已於 10 月 29 日全球上線，加入 Marian: Queen、Hongryeon: Goddeath、免費 SSR Rapunzel: Sanctuary、主線第 49–50 章，以及最多約 259 次免費招募；第二波 11 月 5 日。
items.note: Games Press / Level Infinite Oct 29.
items.imageAlt: NIKKE 4th Anniversary update promotional art
